explanation: A circle is every point that sits exactly r away from a fixed center (h, k) — the equation is just the distance formula set equal to r and squared. Slide h and k to drag the whole circle around the plane without changing its size, and slide r to grow or shrink it about that center. The rotating spoke shows the radius staying the same length no matter which direction it points, which is the entire definition of a circle.
bullets: (h, k) is the center; r is the constant distance to every point.
h and k translate the circle; only r changes its size.
The equation is the distance formula: √((x−h)²+(y−k)²) = r, squared.
